scope: Targeted primary-source screen; not a systematic or full-paper review. No benchmark reproduced in this research turn.

sources.title: TARD: Test-time domain adaptation for robust fault detection under evolving operating conditions
sources.implication: Separating controls and sensor measurements during adaptation is already proposed.

sources.title: CANDI: Curated Test-Time Adaptation for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection Under Distribution Shift
sources.inspection: primary abstract; venue PDF indexed abstract
sources.implication: Selective adaptation to potential false positives is a direct precedent.

sources.title: TTA2D: Bilevel Test-Time Adaptation with EVT Thresholding for Robust Industrial Time Series Anomaly Detection
sources.implication: Anomaly-contaminated adaptation and threshold changes are explicitly addressed.

sources.title: Monitoring Risks in Test-Time Adaptation
sources.implication: Risk monitoring for adapting models without test labels is established.

sources.title: BoTTA: Benchmarking On-device Test Time Adaptation
sources.implication: On-device adaptation windows and resource constraints are not a new setting.

sources.title: When Should We Intervene at Test Time? (PORTAL)
sources.implication: Intervention selection with sparse feedback and query stopping has close prior art.

sources.title: Not all those who drift are lost: Drift correction and calibration scheduling for the IoT
sources.implication: Probabilistic drift correction and reference-calibration scheduling are established.

sources.title: Value-Based Active Sensing for Demand-Driven Adaptive Sampling
sources.implication: Decision-value sensing and safeguards for imperfect belief models have a direct thesis precedent.

sources.title: Resource-Aware Safety-First Active Sensor Acquisition with Few-Shot Commissioning for Edge Fault Warning
sources.inspection: primary indexed abstract and baseline/discussion sections
sources.implication: Confirmation, watchdogs, unseen-fault escalation and target commissioning already coexist.

sources.title: The Decision Value of Perception Compute
sources.implication: More perception computation is not an assumed downstream decision upper bound.

sources.title: Hierarchical Residual Attribution with Supervised Channel Shortlisting for Sensor-Local and Process Fault Diagnosis in Multivariate Sensor Time Series
sources.implication: Sensor-local versus process diagnosis has direct residual-based injected-perturbation prior art; not field fault validation.

sources.title: Data-Driven Calibration and Reference-Free Drift Detection for Multi-Modal Sensor Systems
sources.implication: Cross-sensor inconsistency monitoring is already studied; source distinguishes injected drift from real ageing.

sources.title: Physics-Guided Compositional Diagnosis of Unseen Compound Faults in Variable-Speed Induction Motors
sources.inspection: primary indexed method and evaluation sections
sources.implication: Single-fault-only training and unknown fault cardinality have a close physical-composition precedent.

sources.title: Physics-guided compositional diffusion with confidence-rectified ensemble for generalized zero-shot compound fault diagnosis
sources.inspection: primary indexed introduction and stated dictionary assumption
sources.implication: Generalized zero-shot composition is crowded; specified candidate dictionaries differ from genuinely unknown mechanisms.

sources.title: Safe, Real-Time Active Model Discrimination and Fault Diagnosis for Nonlinear Systems via Differentiable Reachability
sources.inspection: primary selected formulation, Algorithm 1, examples; author source inspection
sources.implication: Active nonlinear discrimination and no-consistent-model outcomes are established; do not omit these comparators.

sources.title: Input design for active fault diagnosis
sources.inspection: primary review abstract and discussion section
sources.implication: Background: input design is mature and mismatch limits model-based guarantees.

sources.title: Integrated Passive-Active Model Identification with Tunable Model Discrimination for Affine Discrete-Time Systems
sources.implication: Combining passive invalidation with active discrimination and lookup trees is established.

sources.title: Active Model Discrimination Using Partition-Based Output Feedback Input Design
sources.implication: Offline synthesis and output-dependent probe lookup are strong conventional alternatives.

sources.title: Diagnosis with Incomplete Models: Diagnosing Hidden Interaction Faults
sources.inspection: primary indexed conclusion and formulation examples
sources.implication: Incomplete models and hidden interaction faults are long-established diagnosis problems.

sources.title: Model Invalidation for Switched Affine Systems with Applications to Fault and Anomaly Detection
sources.implication: Receding-horizon model validation is an essential simple alternative to forced-choice classification.

sources.title: Improving Robustness to Model Misspecification in Bayesian Experimental Design
sources.inspection: primary indexed abstract/method excerpt; direct PDF browser challenge
sources.implication: Auxiliary models and an explicit correctness variable already target learning, prediction and model validation jointly.

sources.title: Maximin Robust Bayesian Experimental Design
sources.inspection: primary abstract and November 8 revision metadata opened
sources.implication: Robust objectives under misspecification are direct algorithmic competitors; paper reports NeurIPS 2026 acceptance.

sources.title: DiffBED: Scaling Bayesian Experimental Design to High-Dimensions
sources.implication: Experimental design exploiting inaccurate likelihood regions and realism constraints are already explicit.

sources.title: Bayesian experimental design for model discrepancy calibration: An auto-differentiable ensemble Kalman inversion approach
sources.implication: Designing measurements to characterize discrepancy is already studied; not a new generic objective.

sources.title: LUCA: A Synthetic World for Experimental Reasoning
sources.inspection: primary selected design, baseline/failure discussion; checked subsequent author disclosure
sources.implication: Relevant experimental-agent setting, but published quantitative comparisons are not used because of disclosed engine/analysis issues.

sources.title: LUCA known issues, updated November 12, 2026
sources.inspection: author disclosure read through GitHub connector
sources.implication: Ignored interventions, baseline errors and held-out/scoring issues materially constrain use of published comparisons.

sources.title: Ashfall: negative-results studies of failure-driven robot learning and simulator diagnosis
sources.inspection: author README and study summaries read through GitHub connector
sources.implication: CPU toy active diagnosis tied an optimized fixed probe; no physical-robot generalization is claimed.

sources.title: netfd: active fault diagnosis for networked LTI systems via nu-gap and PPO
sources.implication: Frequency-informed probes, Bayesian updates and learned sequencing already have a public example; not treated as peer-reviewed evidence.

sources.title: Design-Time Optimization of Deep Neural Networks for Intermittent Learning on Microcontrollers
sources.implication: Intermittent learning costs including checkpointing already motivate design optimization.

sources.title: Assessing Fixed-Batch Reporting for Deadline-constrained Inference in Intermittently Powered IoT
sources.implication: Fixed batching, timing, persistent state and inferential value have an exact-model precedent.

sources.title: In-Orbit Intelligence or Ground Offloading? Inference Freshness under Intermittent Satellite Connectivity
sources.implication: Local compute, cached semantics, offloading and waiting already appear in a freshness optimization model.

sources.title: Bridging Edge and Cloud: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Efficient Time Series Anomaly Detection
sources.implication: Compression, edge/cloud refinement and adaptation are established system ingredients.

sources.title: Decouple to adaptive diagnosis: A dual-head open-set framework for cross-condition injection molding process
sources.implication: Open-set domain adaptation with alignment and rejection decoupled has direct process-industry prior art.

sources.title: Representation stability is not detectability: A leakage-free evaluation of frozen time series foundation models for anomaly detection under concept drift
sources.implication: Frozen foundation representations require cheap statistics and calibration baselines; no architecture assumption of superiority.

sources.title: Aalto Gear Fault datasets for deep-learning based diagnosis
sources.implication: Candidate measured multi-sensor diagnosis data; observational records do not provide arbitrary intervention counterfactuals.

sources.title: System-Self as a Data Structure: An Architectural Approach to Bounded Adaptation
sources.implication: Reasoning over sensor/actuator configurations under faults is already proposed; structure-aware adaptation alone is not a new niche.
